name: OANDA
description: Live OANDA prices for forex, metals and CFDs (OANDA:EURUSD …) from a free OANDA demo account's API token.

settings.label: API token
settings.help: From your OANDA hub: Tools > API (Manage API Access) > Generate.

settings.label: Account
settings.help: Demo for a token of a demo account, Live for a token of a real-money account.

settings.label: Account ID (optional)
settings.help: Leave empty to use the token's first account.

setup:
1. Open a free OANDA demo account (oanda.com, email only, no deposit).
2. In the OANDA hub: Tools > API (Manage API Access) > Generate a token.
3. Here: Settings, paste it in API token, keep Account: Demo, Apply.
Then search OANDA: in the symbol search, or open the ready-made lists in the watchlist menu > Open list… > OANDA.
